enforcement_authorities: 内閣府知的財産戦略推進事務局
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a non-binding guidebook (ガイドブック) intended to provide practical guidance for content production industries (game, anime, advertising) on appropriate use of generative AI. It explicitly states it does not interpret copyright law or guarantee legality. It is positioned below binding government guidelines (AI事業者ガイドライン) and is intended as a practical companion to those instruments. Content reflects information as of June 2024.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document's primary stated reason for governance is protecting intellectual property rights and other legal interests (著作権等の権利・利益の保護) of creators and rights holders when using generative AI in content production. Rights protection language appears in the stated purpose, throughout use-case descriptions, and in the positioning section. A secondary frame of innovation enablement is also strong, as the document encourages appropriate and active use of generative AI to enhance creativity and efficiency. Consumer/public safety appears in references to preventing misinformation and controlling inappropriate outputs.
